items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Even Art Tatum one time got mad because he couldn't hear the piano, people was talking.

ctx.x: Yes, . They didn't ask me to. I don't know, maybe somebody went in there and blowed loud, so from then on they put it in

the contract, please keep a mute in at all...... In fact, they wanted the room so people could talk. People would come in there to sell real estate over their dinner and they would talk. That would bug a lot of people. A lot of people would walk off the stand, and I've seen them do that, get up. Even Art Tatum one time got mad because he couldn't hear the piano, people was talking.
But really that's what they came in there to do, was talk. And not all of them because there were a lot of jazz fans, a lot of jazz fans.
